# hostinger_vps_virtual_machine_hostname (Resource)

Manages the hostname of a VPS virtual machine in the Hostinger account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the VPS virtual machine.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the VPS virtual machine.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Whether to wait for the action to complete before returning. Defaults to true.
